raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Pin Transformer Engine to `44f31bbeaf99bd30a67b928000d4b980026debd2`, the tip of [`release_v2.20.2-nemo`](https://github.com/NVIDIA/TransformerEngine/tree/release_v2.20.2-nemo) resolved on 2026-10-09, and update the source metadata to `2.20.2+44f31bbe`.

The [one-commit update](https://github.com/NVIDIA/TransformerEngine/compare/6ea2a74a9e98c99e6d7b164a33775cc457520027...44f31bbeaf99bd30a67b928000d4b980026debd2) enables deterministic dprob for the GLU fused grouped MLP. Upstream packaging requirements and submodule revisions are unchanged.

Rebased onto `main` at `ebb93b2eda9f820f5c32f36152e84b21ae728a56` and regenerated `uv.lock` with the repository-pinned uv 0.7.2 inside the dev CI container. The final diff changes only the TE source revision and version metadata; all other dependency data matches `main`, including its newer DeepGEMM and ModelOpt pins. LTS pins are unchanged.

Companion Megatron-Bridge update: https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/pull/6384. Both updates select the same TE source revision; merge this MLM PR first. The Bridge PR currently pins the original MLM snapshot `4e7f45066b37a88060058ff012eeacb37c90f7d0`.

Validation:
- `uv lock` and `uv lock --check` passed again after resolving the conflicts on 2026-10-10 in the dev CI container.
- Executed the target checkout's upstream `te_version()` and confirmed `2.20.2+44f31bbe`.
- Lock audit of all 307 packages confirmed that both TOML files are identical to `main` apart from the intended TE SHA/version substitutions.
- `BASE_REF=main CHECK_ONLY=true SKIP_DOCS=false bash tools/autoformat.sh` passed (no changed Python files).
- `git diff --check` passed.
- Native build, GPU runtime tests, and full CI validation have not been run for this revision.

- [ ] I, the PR author, have personally reviewed every line of this PR.
